tests.name: merge_diff_basic_primitives
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff when source and target are non-object primitives, expecting target to be returned.

tests.name: merge_diff_empty_objects
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff between two empty objects, expecting an empty object diff.

tests.name: merge_diff_added_key
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff when a key is added in the target object.

tests.name: gen_04
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff with objects where a key from source is missing in target, producing a null value in the patch.

tests.name: gen_05
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff with objects where a value is changed and an added member exists in target.

tests.name: gen_06
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff with nested objects requiring recursive diffing and checking non-empty nested diffs.

tests.name: gen_07
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff with deeply nested objects exceeding recursion depth to trigger merge_diff_iteratively.

tests.name: gen_08
tests.intent: Probes merge_diff where nested objects have added members within the iterative fallback path.
